text:
The requested Gate 2 revisions have been applied and validated with `plan-lint`:

1. **`header.json`**:
   - Updated the changeset decision to reflect the 6-changeset split, plain adopter-facing messages without internal code symbols, and the `patch` bump for `@backstage/cli-module-new`.
   - Added the `reports-ci` project check (`yarn build:api-reports:only --ci packages/test-utils && yarn build:knip-reports --ci packages/cli-module-build plugins/app`).
2. **`units-004.json`**:
   - Replaced hand-edit units `U77`, `U78`, and `U79` with path-scoped `tooling` units running `yarn build:api-reports packages/test-utils` (`U77`, depending on `U16`, `U58`, `U75`, `U76`), `yarn build:knip-reports packages/cli-module-build` (`U78`, depending on `U58`, `U64`, `U65`, `U66`, `U67`), and `yarn build:knip-reports plugins/app` (`U79`, depending on `U24`, `U58`).
3. **`units-005.json`**:
   - Replaced `U83` with six changeset units (`U83`–`U88`) in `.changeset/`, one per distinct adopter-facing message in plain adopter language with no internal code symbols:
     - `U83` (`.changeset/require-react-18.md`): 54 published packages narrowing React peer ranges to `^18.0.0` (17 `major`, 37 `minor`).
     - `U84` (`.changeset/test-utils-remove-legacy-root.md`): `@backstage/test-utils` (`major`) removing the `legacyRoot` render option.
     - `U85` (`.changeset/cli-drop-react-17.md`): `@backstage/cli-module-build` and `@backstage/cli-module-test-jest` (`minor`) dropping React 17 support in build and test tooling.
     - `U86` (`.changeset/cli-new-react-18-templates.md`): `@backstage/cli-module-new` (`patch`) templates generating packages that require React 18.
     - `U87` (`.changeset/repo-tools-peer-deps-react-18.md`): `@backstage/repo-tools` (`minor`) `peer-deps` check requiring `^18.0.0` ranges.
     - `U88` (`.changeset/ui-dependency-cleanup.md`): `@backstage/ui` (`patch`) dependency cleanup.
